claims.sourceText: AARO Aluminum Materials Analysis Supplement, January 2026
claims.text: AARO's January 2026 Aluminum Materials Analysis Supplement (26-P-0218) reports ORNL analysis of a specimen recovered near Flint Ridge State Park, Ohio, finding it similar to Aluminum Association reference alloys 369.1 and A413.1 with no radioactive emissions.
AARO's January 2026 aluminium materials analysis was performed by Oak Ridge National Laboratory under contract to AARO beginning in 2024.

claims.sourceText: AARO Aluminum Materials Analysis Supplement, document 26-P-0218
claims.text: AARO's January 2026 Aluminum Materials Analysis Supplement reports that Oak Ridge National Laboratory analysis of a specimen recovered near Flint Ridge, Ohio found it consistent with conventional aluminium-silicon casting alloys, with no radioactive emissions detected.

The former AARO director is a senior technology executive at the national laboratory that performed both of AARO's published specimen analyses, including the January 2026 aluminium analysis. Reasoning: his ORNL role dates from December 2023 and the ORNL/AARO aluminium supplement is dated January 2026.
